ai_summary: Single TFLite model used by AiWeakSignalForecastService for weak-signal forecasting: every 100 ms it samples LTE/NR RSRP, RSRQ, SINR and a PCI-change flag; every 1 s it median-filters 100 samples per metric into a float32 [1,400,1] tensor and classifies the next state as WEAK or STRONG with a 2-class CNN+MLP. No audio processing or other AI features exist in the APK.

features.name: Weak-signal forecast (LTE/NR radio metrics -> WEAK/STRONG)
entrypoints: com.xiaomi.mtb.MtbBroadcastReceiver.onReceive (SECRET_CODE host 24744625 / action com.xiaomi.mtb.aisignal.GAME_STATUS, QCOM hook type 2)
pipeline: OemHookAgent.getLteMeasInfo/getNr5gMeasInfo every 100 ms; range-check RSRP [-150,-30] dBm, RSRQ [-40,10] dB, SINR [-20,40] dB
append infoItem(RSRP, RSRQ, SINR, PCI-changed?1:0) to a 100-entry ArrayDeque
every 1000 ms: medianFilter(RSRP,5) -> x[0..99], medianFilter(RSRQ,5) -> x[100..199], medianFilter(SINR,5) -> x[200..299], raw PCI-change flag -> x[300..399]
no normalization: raw dB values written into float32 input [1,400,1]
output[0][1] < 0.5 ? WEAK : STRONG; broadcast extra FORECAST_RES / binder getForecastRes; Log.d tag forecastRes
features.notes: Only model call site in the APK. Voice/audio strings and the SAR AudioTrack tone are unrelated to the model. Class 1 = STRONG is inferred from the Java threshold branch; no label file exists.

models.format: TFLite TFL3 flatbuffer (model version 3, MLIR converted, min_runtime_version 1.10.0)
models.verification: verified: tflite2jax + ai_edge_litert, random max_abs 0; derived median-filtered series max_abs 1.49e-08; 58-case suite worst max_abs 1.416e-06 (tol 1e-4), 0 failures

reimplementation.limitations: Model weights are fully real and numerically matched. The Java preprocessing is ported exactly in preprocess.py (median window 5 with clipped edge windows, raw dB values, 0/1 PCI-change flag). The model's training data and the semantics behind the WEAK/STRONG threshold are not present in the APK; class 1 = STRONG is inferred from the Java branch. The model is a radio-metric classifier, not an audio classifier, so the demo uses synthetic 100-sample measurement series rather than a waveform.

data_pipelines.name: AI weak-signal forecast (LTE/NR radio metrics -> WEAK/STRONG)

triggers.mechanism: android.provider.Telephony.SECRET_CODE (scheme android_secret_code, host 24744625) -> MtbBroadcastReceiver.onReceive -> AiWeakSignalForecastService.onAiSignalBcHandle (static-boolean toggle: startService / stopService+Toast)

triggers.surface: broadcast com.xiaomi.mtb.aisignal.GAME_STATUS (extra gameStatus; 0 = stop, non-zero = restart)
triggers.mechanism: MtbBroadcastReceiver.onReceive -> AiWeakSignalForecastService.onAiSignalGameStatusBcHandle; started instance gets extra GAME_BroadCast=True, which enables the 1 Hz FORECAST_RES broadcast
triggers.note: The manifest declares GAME_START/GAME_EXIT, not GAME_STATUS, so only an explicit broadcast to the component reaches this handler; the declared GAME_START/GAME_EXIT actions are ignored by the code.

triggers.mechanism: exported service with no permission; binder returns mForecastRes and ignores the argument; bind path never sets isfrombroadcast, so no broadcast is emitted for bind-only clients

measurement_source.selector: TelephonyManager.getNetworkType(): 13 = LTE -> getLteMeasInfo(slot), 20 = NR -> getNr5gMeasInfo(slot), other types append a stale sample; slot = SubscriptionManager.getPhoneId(getActiveDataSubscriptionId()) mapped to 0 unless 1
measurement_source.stack: com.xiaomi.modem.OemHookAgent (in APK) -> reflection into /system_ext/framework/mirilhook.jar com.xiaomi.mirilhook.MiRilHook -> HydraDataManager modem-stats DB
measurement_source.hook_readiness: OemHookAgent.getHook() returns null until the qcrilhook callback onQcRilHookReady sets mMiRilHookReady; initService probes with getLteMeasInfo(0) in a catch(NullPointerException) and never retries

transport.record: infoItem{String time; float RSRP, RSRQ, SINR, PCI} where PCI is a 0.0/1.0 PCI-change flag
transport.units: RSRP dBm (-150..-30 accepted), RSRQ dB (-40..10), SINR dB (-20..40), flag 0/1
transport.timestamp: new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()).toString().substring(11) = HH:mm:ss.mmm; stored but never used by the pipeline
transport.buffer_layout_lte: ByteBuffer relative reads: get() @0, getInt() @1, 13x getFloat() @5..56, RSRP @57, RSRQ @61, SINR @65, PCI getInt() @69 (>=73 bytes)
transport.buffer_layout_nr: get() @0, 4x getFloat() @1..16, RSRQ @17, 4x getFloat() @21..36, PCI getInt() @37, RSRP @41, SINR @45 (>=49 bytes)
transport.queue: java.util.ArrayDeque, depth 100, drop-oldest; produced by the 10 Hz task, consumed by the 1 Hz task on a different thread from the same 10-thread pool with no synchronization
transport.buffer_ownership: a fresh ByteBuffer per call, consumed once by relative getters, never rewound/duplicated/cleared/reused
transport.confidence: confirmed (offsets, queue, thread pool), inferred (race consequences)

steps: copy deque into per-metric float[100] arrays in oldest->newest order; PCI-change flag written to input[0][300+i][0]
medianFilter(w=5) per metric: centred window, clipped at the edges (lengths 3,4,5 at the head and 5,4,3 at the tail), even-length windows averaged
write filtered RSRP -> input[0][0..99][0], RSRQ -> [100..199], SINR -> [200..299]; flag stays raw
preprocessing.normalization: none; raw dBm/dB and 0/1 written into float32
preprocessing.shape: float32[1,400,1], reused buffer allocated once in initService
preprocessing.window: 100 samples x 100 ms = 10 s, stride 1 s (overlapping)

model.runtime: bundled TFLite Java API (org.tensorflow.lite.e = Interpreter); zero-copy AssetFileDescriptor + FileChannel.map(READ_ONLY) into new e(MappedByteBuffer)
model.options: none (no delegates, no thread count, no NNAPI/GPU)
model.cadence: 1 s; inference runs only when inputDeque.size() == 100; session created once per initService and never closed

postprocessing.threshold: output[0][1] < 0.5f -> WEAK else STRONG (softmax already in-graph)
postprocessing.formatting: literal strings WEAK / STRONG; default sentinel NOT Ready; no score/timestamp/window id exposed

consumers.target: implicit com.xiaomi.mtb.aisignal.FORECAST_RES with String extra FORECAST_RES, sent every second only when started via GAME_STATUS
IAiWeakSignal.getForecastRes(String) returns mForecastRes (argument ignored), no caller permission

lifecycle.start: onStartCommand -> initService(intent) -> apply cloud switch, resolve hook, allocate [1,400,1]/[1,2], create interpreter, create 10-thread scheduler, schedule 100 ms + 1000 ms fixed-rate tasks; then read GAME_BroadCast extra; then isServiceRunning = true
lifecycle.bind: onBind -> initService(intent) (isfrombroadcast stays false) -> return IAiWeakSignal.Stub
lifecycle.stop: secret-code toggle or GAME_STATUS gameStatus==0 -> Context.stopService; onDestroy -> mExecutor.shutdown(); isServiceRunning = false
lifecycle.wake_locks: none (no PowerManager/WifiLock/AlarmManager/JobScheduler); no foreground service or notification
lifecycle.cancellation: only ExecutorService.shutdown(); no shutdownNow/Future.cancel; interpreter and mapped model are never closed
lifecycle.screen_off: no wake lock -> sampling pauses with CPU; scheduleAtFixedRate catches up in a burst after resume (monotonic clock stops during suspend)
defects: stopSelf() on cloud-control property == "true" is not followed by return, so the service stops and still schedules both tasks
an exception inside either Runnable (null hook, BufferUnderflow, null interpreter) permanently cancels that fixed-rate task; no retry or watchdog
START_STICKY restart with a null Intent: initService runs, then intent.getStringExtra(...) NPEs before isServiceRunning is set -> a second executor can be created while the first leaks
onDestroy calls mExecutor.shutdown() without a null check

failure_fallback.effect: NPE in getCurrentInfo kills the 100 ms sampler; label freezes
logged, previous field values re-appended as a fresh sample
loader swallows the exception, mTFLite stays null, run() NPEs and cancels the 1 Hz forecaster
forecast skipped, but NOT Ready is still broadcast/bindable every second
